description.value: The Basic is a family-owned breakfast and lunch restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, previously known as Joe's Grill, with over 30 years serving the local community. Classic homemade dishes — eggs Florentine, French toast, pulled pork hash — are made with locally sourced ingredients in a friendly neighbourhood-diner setting. Outdoor seating makes it a practical mid-ride refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the West End.
